question_text: A portable diagnostic workstation supports both twisted-pair Ethernet and Wi-Fi. Justify providing both for a technician who transfers large files at a fixed desk and moves between rooms.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Ethernet provides a stable connection and avoids radio interference at the desk. Wi-Fi enables movement without trailing cables and connection where wired ports are unavailable. Thus each link supports a different working condition.

marking_points.criterion: Links it to desk/large-transfer context without universal speed claim.
